utilitiesNote: Flat $100 per person each month, internet included.

levels.name: Lower
levels.note: A self-contained floor: the lower level has a living room and kitchen of its own.

levels.name: Main
levels.note: The main floor holds the house's principal living room and kitchen.

levels.name: Upper
levels.note: Two bedrooms sharing a bathroom, above the main floor.

terms.label: Long term
terms.title: 2120 NE 54th St — rooms by the bedroom in Ravenna, Seattle
terms.description: A 10-bedroom, 6-bath house with two kitchens in Ravenna, on leases of 8 to 12 months. Rent a single bedroom or a pair.
terms.leaseNote: Leases run from 8 to 12 months, so a school year or a full year both work.
terms.crossLink: Staying eight months or more? The long-term site has the standard rates, plus the pairs.

terms.label: Short term
terms.title: 2120 NE 54th St — short-term rooms in Ravenna, Seattle
terms.description: Single bedrooms in a 10-bedroom, 6-bath Ravenna house on leases of 3 to 7 months, from $1,000 a month with utilities at a flat $100 per person.
terms.leaseNote: Leases run from 3 to 7 months. A room on a short lease is $150 above the long-term rate, or $200 for a room with its own bathroom.
terms.crossLink: Staying under eight months? The short-term site has the ten rooms on leases of 3 to 7 months.

furnishing.note: Every room can be furnished at no extra cost with a bed and a desk. Take it furnished or bring your own — either way the rent is the same.

nearby.name: Ravenna Park
nearby.note: The ravine's edge is a couple of minutes' walk east.

nearby.name: Burke-Gilman Trail
nearby.note: Roughly a five-minute walk to the nearest access point.

nearby.name: University of Washington
nearby.note: To the north edge of campus at NE 45th St — about 15 minutes on foot, or five by bike.
